Religious freedom is a right so fundamental, the Founders included it in the First Amendment.

Today, on National Religious Freedom Day, we stand on the shoulders of giants who gave everything so that you and I can freely exercise our faith.

Proud to lead this critical legislation. 

The Lymphedema Treatment Act will improve insurance coverage for the prescribed medical compression garments that are key to managing this chronic disease, helping the 5 million impacted Americans live their healthiest lives.

5 million Americans suffer from lymphedema, the majority of whom are cancer survivors. 

We must pass the Lymphedema Treatment Act to get these patients the access, help, and support they need. 

Read more in my @thehill op-ed with @RepDeSaulnier ⬇️
